name: Seed to Forest Accelerator
summary: Terraformation pays planting costs for large native reforestation projects in the tropics and subtropics and lines up forward carbon sales, with training, seed banking and monitoring support. Teams need long-term rights to thousands of hectares and apply online to join a cohort.

steps: Interview and technical screening, if a good candidate

eligibility.rule: Hold long-term reforestation rights and access: ≥3,000 ha in Colombia, Ghana, Kenya or Philippines; ≥15,000 ha elsewhere
Have proven native-ecosystem reforestation experience in a similar eco-region
Plan forests that last at least 40 years and benefit the environment and surrounding communities
Reforest in a tropical or subtropical location

effort.quote: Our application takes about 90 minutes to complete.
If your project is a good candidate for a future Accelerator cohort, you’ll interview with a project lead and work with our forestry and carbon teams on a more thorough technical screening.

eligibility.quote: Have long-term access and rights to reforest at least 3,000 hectares of land in Colombia, Ghana, Kenya, or the Philippines - or at least 15,000 hectares in other countries
Have proven experience in native ecosystem reforestation within a similar eco-region
Are focused on restoring forests that last for generations (minimum 40 years) and benefit the environment and communities around those forests
Our forestry accelerator is designed to support organizations focused on tropical or subtropical reforestation projects and communities only
